trigger_description: state[31:24]==0x7E AND key[31:24]==0x3D, same applied cycle (P=2^-16 under random input). Detect flag pipelined through a 20-stage shift register matched to the core's measured 21-cycle latency.
observable_effect: Bit 48 of the final-round key input is XORed with bit 0 of the captured key register on the aligned output cycle -- i.e. one bit of the registered AES key is multiplexed onto the ciphertext only when the trigger condition holds, leaking that key bit through a 1-bit ciphertext deviation. Produces no deviation at all when the leaked key bit happens to be 0 (deviation value equals the secret bit itself, not a fixed corruption).

activation_vector_used_for_eval2.note: key bit 0 is 1 in this vector so the leak is visible as a ciphertext deviation.
